name: Zung Member API
description:
The Zung Member API is the API behind the Zung mobile app. It lets you build
**member-facing** channels on top of a Zung-powered SACCO or MFI: a branded
mobile app, a WhatsApp/USSD bot, a member portal.

## Who a token belongs to

Every token is issued to **one member** (a client with portal access) and
can only ever see that member's own data. It is not a back-office API: it
cannot list other members, post transactions, or read the institution's
books.

## Authentication

1. `POST /login` with the institution's Zung subdomain (`business`), the
   member's username or email (`login`) and password.
2. Send the returned `token` on every other request as
   `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
3. `POST /logout` revokes it. Tokens do not expire on their own, so revoke
   them when the member signs out.

Always send `Accept: application/json`; without it, authentication errors
may come back as redirects instead of JSON.

## Prerequisites on the institution's side

Login only succeeds if the institution has the client portal (CRM module)
in its Zung subscription, and the member has a portal login that is
active, allowed to log in, and linked to their client profile.

## Errors

Every error body has the same shape: `{"message": "..."}`. Validation
errors (`422`) report the first failing field only.

## Rate limits

Limits are counted per client IP address:

- `POST /login`: 10 requests per minute.
- Everything else: 60 requests per minute.

Exceeding a limit returns `429` with a `Retry-After` header (seconds).
Call the API from the member's own device where you can; a server that
proxies many members' traffic shares one IP's allowance.

## Lists

List endpoints return the member's **50 most recent** records, newest
first. There is no pagination.

## Numbers and dates

Money amounts are JSON numbers (not strings). Dates are `YYYY-MM-DD`
strings in the institution's local calendar; `submitted_at` on loan
applications is a full ISO 8601 timestamp.
